value.title: Complete derived tiles keep bounded shared cache accounting and cancellable pre-dispatch admission
value.statement: Direct SQLite tile consumers share the canonical-root cache ledger per operation. Hot publication cannot inventory or sort the entire cache catalog on every put; bootstrap and reconciliation are separate bounded ownership events. Preserve full PBF bytes, byte/file/ entry budgets, atomic temporary-file publication, safe cache misses and SQLite authority. Native current guards apply inside optional disk publication; Arbitrary external concurrent cache writers are not assumed supported. Android cache loss must not lose project data. A shared cancellable two-permit admission precedes native blocking IO dispatch across layers. Canceled SDK waiters do not enqueue a blocking payload each. A permit belongs to actual IO until it unwinds, releases before Main completion and releases exactly once on all paths. SDK Job demand remains authoritative: never discard a valid parent/fade/adjacent tile by heuristic age, zoom or density. This is not a bound on SDK pending jobs or the separate line label query scheduler. New source/content/style guards, editor originals, scale gates and complete geometry/identity/label output stay unchanged. JVM/build checks do not certify real device speed, final frame contents, low-RAM behavior or a two-second target.
